Package com.ucm.server.evaluator

Class Evaluator

java.lang.Object
com.ucm.server.evaluator.Evaluator
public class Evaluator extends Object
Utility class responsible for evaluating poker hands.

This implementation is based on a fast 5-card poker hand evaluation algorithm using precomputed lookup tables.

Adapted from: Cactus Kev's Poker Hand Evaluator (http://suffe.cool/poker/evaluator.html)

  • Method Details

    • getInstance

      public static Evaluator getInstance() throws EvaluatorException
      Returns the singleton instance of the Evaluator class. If the instance has not been created yet, it will be initialized by calling the private constructor, which loads the lookup tables used for hand evaluation.
      Returns:
      the singleton instance of the Evaluator class
      Throws:
      EvaluatorException - if there is an error loading the lookup tables, such as missing or malformed files.
      See Also:
      • Evaluator()

    • evaluateAllHands

      public List<PlayerEvaluation> evaluateAllHands(List<HandInfo> playerHands, com.ucm.common.gameobjects.Card[] tableCards)
      Evaluates the best poker hand for each player based on their hole cards and the community cards on the table. The method calculates the best 5-card hand for each player by considering all possible combinations of their hole cards and the community cards, and returns a list of PlayerEvaluation objects containing the player ID and their best hand value.
      Parameters:
      playerHands - a list of HandInfo objects representing the hole cards of each player, where each HandInfo object contains the player ID and their two hole cards
      tableCards - an array of Card objects representing the community cards on the table (flop, turn, and river)
      Returns:
      a list of PlayerEvaluation objects, where each object contains the player ID and their best hand value based on the evaluated hands

    • evaluate5hand

      public short evaluate5hand(int card1, int card2, int card3, int card4, int card5)
      Evaluates the best 5-card poker hand from the given 5 encoded card values. The method uses precomputed lookup tables to efficiently determine the rank of the hand based on the encoded card values, which include information about the card ranks and suits.
      Parameters:
      card1 - the encoded value of the first card
      card2 - the encoded value of the second card
      card3 - the encoded value of the third card
      card4 - the encoded value of the fourth card
      card5 - the encoded value of the fifth card
      Returns:
      a short value representing the rank of the best 5-card hand, where lower values indicate stronger hands (e.g., a straight flush has a lower value than a high card)

    • getRankName

      public static String getRankName(short val)
      Returns the name of the poker hand rank corresponding to the given hand value. The method uses the handRank(short) method to determine the rank of the hand based on the provided hand value, and then returns the name of the rank as a string.
      Parameters:
      val - the hand value for which to determine the rank name
      Returns:
      the name of the poker hand rank

    • handRank

      public static Evaluator.RANK handRank(short val)

      Parameters:

      Returns:

    • encodeCard

      public static int encodeCard(com.ucm.common.gameobjects.Card c)
      Encodes a Card object into an integer representation used for hand evaluation. The encoding includes information about the card's rank, suit, and a unique prime number associated with the card's rank, allowing for efficient hand evaluation using precomputed lookup tables.
      Parameters:
      c - the Card object to encode, which contains the card's rank and suit
      Returns:
      the encoded integer value representing the card
